name: Crystallized Ball
description: WebGL glowing crystal sphere with electric strands, flares, sparks and a cloud of dust particles. Reacts to the pointer with heat and stirring, and ships eight color presets.
contents: Single full-size container div that holds a WebGL canvas
Glowing ball with crackling strands, flares and sparks
Particle dust cloud around the ball with haze
behavior: Renders through OGL with WebGL2 and float render targets when available
Pointer movement and press on the window heat and stir the ball and dust, with a looking-toward-pointer sway
Optional intro animation when the ball appears
Pauses rendering when scrolled out of view or the tab is hidden
Resolution scales down on large areas to stay within a pixel budget, device pixel ratio capped at 2
editableByProps: Preset look, ball color, light or dark theme and ball size
Strand, crackle, flare, glow and spark intensity
Dust particle count, motion direction, shape, depth, twinkle, haze and speed
Pointer interaction on or off and its strength
Intro animation, pause, overall speed, container class and style

needsCodeEdit.where: BALL_PRESETS constant at the top of the file
PIXEL_BUDGET constant and the renderer.dpr line in the resize function

needsCodeEdit.change: Listen to pointer only inside the container instead of the whole window
needsCodeEdit.where: window.addEventListener calls for pointermove, pointerdown, pointerout and pointerup in the main useEffect

fixed: Needs WebGL2, renders nothing and releases the context when WebGL2 is unavailable
Container fills its parent (w-full h-full), the parent must have a size
Pointer listeners are attached to the window, so the ball reacts to the pointer anywhere on the page
Random layout uses a fixed seed, so the strand and dust layout is the same every load
GPU heavy with large particle counts, may be slow on low-end mobile devices
